name: canvas-hand
description: A local infinite canvas for Codex, powered by tldraw — generate images onto the canvas, annotate with arrows, and let the AI redraw images from your annotations.

interface.shortDescription: Create, annotate, and generate images on a local infinite canvas in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Canvas Hand brings a tldraw-powered infinite canvas into Codex. Open a local canvas, generate AI images onto it, draw arrow annotations with instructions, and let the AI read your annotations and redraw the image accordingly — all kept in your project workspace.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image on my canvas
Redraw this image based on my annotations on the canvas
